description: Gate E (first GRANDE 1.0.0 SpeedDating baseline) and Gate F (runtime benchmarks). All runs: GRANDEClassifier from db79c860, seed 42, dyad-grouped C2 outer fold 0 with grouped inner validation unless stated. Declared before any run: the Gate E primary baseline is E_main.

common_rationale.use_numeric_embeddings=false: no embeddings (federation-compatible model input; also matches E0a/E0b); 1.0.0 default is true
common_rationale.use_class_weights=true: 16.5% positives and macro-F1 at a fixed 0.5 threshold; 1.0.0 default is false
common_rationale.compile_model=false: deterministic engineering baseline; compile speed-up measured separately (F_compile)

runs.label: GRANDE 1.0.0 baseline (not a paper reproduction): 1.0.0 defaults except embeddings off, class weights on, compile off
leakage diagnostic: historical row-wise split (C1) incl. row-wise inner validation; not a valid estimate
